scope_notes: Dedicated source files retain every native column and row, including context fields.
Mixed household files expose only native q13a fields plus available identifiers and weights in Parquet; originals remain complete.
Village medical filenames establish candidate scope, not service-access versus medicine-price semantics.
Health questions embedded in other modules, violence, consumption diaries and integrated village datasets remain a separately flagged discovery queue.
No source presence, equal variable name, code label or sheet name certifies cross-wave comparability.
Physical field occurrences, records, distinct identifiers and actual respondents are different counts.
